PC: Chronic pain: patient education about realistic goals, risks and benefits of opioids, consultation or referral to a pain specialist, consider tapering opioids without rapid taper, non-opioid medications such as NSAIDs or antidepressants, cognitive behavioral therapy, exercise, physical therapy, yoga, acupuncture, or music therapy.
Depression: referral to behavioral health specialist, exercise or physical therapy, consider initiating an antidepressant.
Safety concerns: prescribe naloxone and provide training to patient and spouse, discontinue carisoprodol, provide acetaminophen education, discourage alcohol use.
MK: Chronic musculoskeletal back pain: patient history, PEG screening tool, SP interview.
Depression: patient history, PHQ-9 screening tool, SP interview.
Opioid use disorder (OUD): PMP report, SP interview.
SBP: Safety concerns: high morphine equivalent dose (MED); combining alcohol with opioids and acetaminophen; high daily dose of acetaminophen.

Concerning behaviors: establish a trusting patient-provider relationship, discuss multiple prescribers and opioid volume, consider a pain agreement with single prescriber/single pharmacy and/or urine drug testing, and consider addiction-specialist referral if OUD assessment is needed.
